csv_project_name: DB for MHAFB Air Traffic Control Tower
csv_agency: US Army Corps of Engrs, Seattle District
csv_location: Mountain Home Air Force Base, ID
csv_scope_of_work: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Seattle District, is conducting market research to identify potential sources with the interest and capability to design and construct an Air Traffic Control Tower at Mountain Home Air Force Base, ID. The purpose of this announcement is to identify qualified and interested small businesses in pursuing the construction work identified in Paragraph 3 below. The Government is contemplating a Two-Phase Design Build to Budget (DB2B) procurement for this requirement. Based on the responses received from interested parties, a decision will be made regarding setting construction work aside for small businesses. A Design Build to Budget (DB2B) contract is designed to streamline project delivery for an owner s challenging requirements and allow the firm to deliver the most innovative design and construction solutions to meet mission requirements.
